description: Use when you need the cheapest place to rent a given GPU. Compares every tracked provider's current list price per GPU-hour, optionally in one region, and returns the cheapest with its source. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

chip.description: GPU family, for example H100, A100, H200, B200, B300 or GB200.

region.description: Only lines in this region, by code or name. Leave out to compare every region.

name: find-cheapest-gpu-hour
title: Cheapest GPU-hour
